item.text: {"answer":"20","solution":"Since both symbols occur, a cyclic string with no 000 or 111 consists of alternating runs of 1s and 0s, each of length 1 or 2. There are eight 1-runs and eight 0-runs. The eight 1-runs contain eight 1s, so each has length 1. The eight 0-runs contain twelve 0s, so exactly four have length 2 and the other four length 1. For a labeled string, choose the position where a 1-run starts (20 choices), then choose which four of the eight successive 0-runs have length 2 (binomial(8,4) choices). Each string is counted eight times, once for each 1-run start. Thus the count is 20·binomial(8,4)/8 = 20.","insight":"A cyclic string with both symbols present and no triple equal symbols has equally many 1-runs and 0-runs.","insight_justification":"On traversing the cycle, runs alternate between 1s and 0s, so every 1-run is paired with a following 0-run."}
